messages.subject: Error in names(typingsX) <- temp
parts:
I have two files that were output by RQTL using write.cross in 2013. (I have many, but the point is there is a group that will load and a group that will not). They are subsets of the same data, and the only difference is total number of markers and individuals.  One group, which has more individuals and fewer markers, loads fine with this command: 

x<-read.cross(format="csv", file="file.csv", na.strings=c("-"), genotypes=c("AA", "AB", "BB"), convertXdata=TRUE)


The other does not, and throws this error. 


Error in names(typingsX) <- temp : 

  'names' attribute [2] must be the same length as the vector [1]


They are subsets of the same data, and I have examined them multiple times for differences like stray commas or extra columns. I've had all of those kinds of problems before though, and they usually throw different and more interpretable errors. The format of the marker names and individual names are the same. 



From what I can tell there has not been a change in acceptable input data since 2013, and since these were output by RQTL I cannot figure out what the problem is. I see that a similar error has been posted before, but no solution was posted.

messages.subject: Re: Error in names(typingsX) <- temp
